patterns.note: Perspective-tilted cards on the left and right edges rotate and slide into view on scroll, creating a 3D depth effect.
High-contrast, asymmetric grid with massive negative space, alternating between pure black and pure white section backgrounds.
Ultra-bold, oversized grotesque sans-serif headlines paired with clean, structured metadata blocks.
A dynamic 'Team' grid featuring floating black-and-white portrait thumbnails that expand or reveal details on hover.

technique_notes: To recreate the 3D perspective card carousel, use CSS 3D transforms (rotateY, perspective) combined with a scroll-driven animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger to dynamically adjust the rotation and horizontal translation of the edge cards as they enter the viewport.
Implement a smooth page-background color transition from deep black to pure white between major sections using intersection observers to toggle theme classes on the body element.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, high-contrast display headings (90px+) paired with compact, highly-readable body text (14px-16px) with tight line-heights.

standout: The design stands out through its dramatic use of 3D-tilted perspective cards on the screen edges, transforming a traditional law firm website into an immersive, editorial digital experience. The stark transition from a pitch-black homepage to a bright white interior team page creates a powerful, high-contrast brand identity.
